messages.subject: Problems with spectro function
parts:
Hi! I want create a spectrogram of advertisment call of a frog species, but when I run this script:

spectro(leprus, flim=c(0,10), tlim=c(1.382,1.395), ovlp=80, heights=c(1,1),  scale=TRUE, osc=TRUE)   

Rstudio show the next: Error in seq.default(flim[1], flim[2], length.out = nrow(z)) :  argument 'length.out' must be of length 1, and I don´t know why. 

Can you help me please?

Best regards,

Raquel

Dear Raquel,
This is probably because you are looking to a too short time section 1.395 - 1.382 = 0.013 s.
Best regards,
Jerome
